summary: TimeZone::from_local_datetime panicked when subtracting a timezone offset pushed a boundary datetime outside the representable range. The fix uses checked subtraction and returns LocalResult::None for out-of-range conversions, including ambiguous offsets. The regression test added by this commit exercises minimum and maximum datetimes across offsets from -23 to +23 hours; the reversed implementation should panic on its first maximum-datetime conversion. No tests were executed.
